argument:
Alphabet's operating income growth of 30%, revenue growth of 24% and operating-margin expansion to 34% support a bullish case independent of investment gains. Cloud revenue grew 82%, giving the thesis a distinct operating growth channel alongside the broader business. A modestly constructive price recovery leaves room for renewed confidence if these operating economics persist.

The $98bn net investment gain makes headline EPS and the 17.38x vendor trailing multiple unreliable anchors for cheapness. Senior-note and equity proceeds also require attention to financing and dilution. Price above both averages and a positive histogram are supportive, but weak volume and negative 60-bar return do not prove a breakout. Sustainable operating returns after AI investment are the argument, not reported net-income acceleration.
key_points: Operating growth and margin expansion remain after separating investment gains.
Cloud growth supplies a concrete upside channel.
Financing, dilution and capex returns prevent a simple low-P/E thesis.
